artboards.title: 3 · Reply composer — AI draft, in-thread send

annotations.text:
THE LOOP (shipped as v1 — this canvas is the review surface; redline anything and it changes)

1 · Send a letter through your own Gmail — one tap, replies tracked on the thread id.
2 · 'Check replies' pulls the agency's responses into the Paper Trail as REPLY entries.
3 · 'Draft a reply with Waypoint' proposes the response; edit, then send — threaded, no copy-paste.

SECURITY POSTURE
· Google refresh token stays server-side (owner-only table, edge function holds the client secret)
· Only threads Waypoint started are read — never the whole inbox
· AI treats thread text as quoted material, not instructions

HONEST CAVEATS (pilot)
· Google shows an 'unverified app' warning at consent — expected pre-CASA
· Testing mode expires the grant ~7 days; reconnect is one tap
· Public rollout of Gmail scopes later requires Google's CASA review

OPEN DESIGN QUESTIONS — your call:
· Should 'Check replies' also run automatically on app open?
· Should a new REPLY ping the Home screen (a 'Lilia replied' card)?
· Reply tone: match the letter tone bar (warm/professional/strong)?
· Should incoming replies auto-run the Email Analyzer (red flags, deadlines)?
